description: Refresh on-chain state EXPLICITLY. You rarely need this — every balance read and every spend already syncs on your behalf (a received payment shows up on the next wallet_get_balances without a manual sync). Call it with rescan:true for a DEEP cold re-scan from zero when balances look desynchronized (missing transactions, stale amounts): that can take several MINUTES. The default incremental sync is ~seconds when warm. Signs nothing, moves no money.

rescan.description: false (default) = fast incremental sync (~seconds warm). true = DEEP cold re-scan from zero — drops the cached update-chain and rebuilds LWK state; use when balances look desynchronized (missing txs, stale amounts). Slower: a rescan can take several MINUTES (10-min budget). Signs nothing.

name: wallet_sync

rescan.description: Whether this ran the deep cold re-scan (true) or the incremental sync (false).

stale.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) before this read/spend FAILED and the result reflects the last persisted snapshot — the on-chain state may be newer. Reads never fail on a provider outage; they serve the snapshot with this flag. Absent means the state was refreshed.

updated.description: Whether the scan produced any new on-chain state since the last sync.

title: Sync the wallet
